title: IPOS2/3 Prepared Equivalent-Depth Response Contract

branches.SERIES: x > 0.5 uses odd terms i=1,3,5 of the exponential series

prepared_geometry.validity: uniform normalized domain requires finite spacing>0, base<=drain bottom, wetted perimeter>0 and positive finite logarithmic denominator when used
prepared_geometry.storage_class: immutable derived parameter/cache shared by columns with the same geometry, not dynamic column state

dynamic_response.sign: q>0 means water leaves soil toward drainage receiver

derivative.stable_active_branch: analytic with prepared equivalent depth constant with respect to gwl
derivative.geometry_branch_derivative: not a soil-water Jacobian derivative; x-branch identity is immutable parameter metadata

ownership.mass_transfer: signed_soil_to_drain_rate is authoritative; runtime owns integration and accepted-ledger publication

holds: No smoothing or interpolation across the equivalent-depth x=0.5 formula-family transition.
No runtime/source-sink binding or DIVDRA composition.
No legacy file parsing or calendar semantics.
No scientific B1.10 equivalence or canonical admission before independent verification.
No promotion of the 1e-10 compatibility cutoff to generic drainage physics.
